preconditions.description: The length of the problem name is not more than 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c.isupper() or c == '_' for c in problem_name)
preconditions.description: The problem name contains only lowercase and uppercase letters and '_' symbols.

postconditions.expression: output == 'YES' if any(name in problem_name for name in ['Danil', 'Olya', 'Slava', 'Ann', 'Nikita']) and problem_name.count(name) == 1 else 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if the problem name contains one of Alex's friends' names exactly once, and 'NO' otherwise.
